body:
**Summer Fiddle Concert / Pot Luck Dinner**

A favorite annual event! The whole family is welcome for dinner and a fun outdoor concert. Casual dress — jeans, shorts, or go country with overalls, cowboy boots, and a hat!

Pot luck: Last names A–M bring a main dish; N–Z bring a salad. Martha provides drinks, dessert, and utensils.

**Suzuki Concert Songs:** Twinkles · Lightly Row · Go Tell Aunt Rhody · Perpetual Motion · Chorus from "Judas Maccabaeus" · Musette · Humoresque · Gavotte by Becker — plus your fiddle piece!
